> Does Jacob's ability fall under the X/Y paradigm w.r.t Anson / The
> Parthenon?

Everything that is written as "During <some timeframe X>, <do some thing Y>"
falls under that template's ruling.

Things that aren't written with that template don't.

Jacob falls in the second category.

> Can I make that Methuselah burn his/her hand 3 times by pitching 3
> master cards?

If you have three master phase actions to spend, yes.
